name: Meru Health
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Helsinki, Finland
long_description: Meru Health is an online provider for greater mental health with remote clinicians (licensed therapists & psychiatrists), a smartphone-based treatment program, a biofeedback wearable and an anonymous peer-support group. Meru Health is committed to evidence-based care and has published groundbreaking clinical outcomes in several peer-reviewed medical journals with Harvard & UC Davis. Meru Health has offices in San Mateo CA, Denver CO and Helsinki, Finland.

launches.title: Meru Health: A precision, whole-person mental healthcare company
launches.tagline: The new standard of mental healthcare
launches.body:
Meru Health is a precision, whole-person mental healthcare company. Today we launched **Meru Health Advanced** — a 6 to 12 month integrated psychiatry and therapy program for the patients standard care has failed most completely: treatment-resistant depression and anxiety, severe mental illness, and mental health stacked on chronic physical illness.

Every patient starts with a real diagnosis: comprehensive psychiatric visits, a 30–50 biomarker lab panel, and a coordinated team — psychiatrist, therapist, dietitian, care navigator — on one platform. Plus continuous biometric data via Whoop, HRV biofeedback, and lab-informed lifestyle and supplement protocols.

Across 17 peer-reviewed studies (Stanford, Harvard, UCSF, UC Davis, Washington, Rutgers), 55–67% of our patients achieve a 50%+ reduction in depression symptoms in 2–3 months — vs 19–33% on SSRIs. Accorded actuarial analysis: 55% fewer inpatient admissions, 31% fewer ER visits, 23% lower Rx costs.

## **Demo video**

<https://youtu.be/KFnCtezutDo>

## **What's the backstory?**

Kristian and his co-founders Riku and Albert founded Meru after Kristian had lost his brother Peter to suicide. Standard psychiatry couldn't help him; the antidepressants he was prescribed only made him worse. He wasn't an outlier — 30–40% of people with mental health conditions get labeled "treatment-resistant," a phrase I read as a confession that the model itself runs out of options after the second or third prescription.

A decade and 45,000 patients in, our 12-week Therapy program is enough for most. But the most complex patients needed something more: a psychiatrist who understands metabolic and lifestyle medicine, comprehensive labs, a dietitian, and a team that operates as one. That combination didn't exist anywhere. So we built it.

## **What are your asks?**

**1. Patient intros** — anyone who's tried the standard path and not gotten better, especially treatment-resistant and severe conditions, or mental health on a chronic illness. <https://www.meruhealth.com/advanced>

**2. Employer / benefits intros** — Advanced is built for the 6–12% of an employee population driving 30–50% of healthcare spend. Self-insured employers, CHROs, total rewards leads.

**3. Payer intros** — actively expanding insurance coverage. Commercial plans, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid.

**4. Amplification** — likes, shares, and tags on today's LinkedIn + X launch posts.

Ten years in, this is the closest we've come to building the program we wished my brother had had.

— Kristian Riku and Albert
